name: DailyWeatherSummary
description: Daily weather summary for a meteorological station, demonstrating the biconditional between derivation and statistic: a statistic keyword MUST be present when and only when derivation is 'statistic'. Temperature extremes and the daily mean are statistics over the 24-hour period; precipitation total is a sum statistic over an accumulation period; station pressure at the end-of-day snapshot is a direct measurement; dew-point depression at the snapshot is a calculated value; and the following-day precipitation probability is a modeled value. The two temporal axes are independent: dayStart and dayEnd bound the period-based statistics and the accumulation, while snapshotTime is the instant for point readings.

stationId.description: WMO station number of the observing station.

dayStart.description: Start of the 24-hour summary period (00:00 UTC), inclusive.

dayEnd.description: End of the 24-hour summary period (00:00 UTC the following day), exclusive.

snapshotTime.description: Fixed-hour observation instant used for end-of-day point readings (23:00 UTC).

summaryPublishedAt.description: Instant at which this daily summary was computed and published.

temperatureMax.description: Greatest air temperature recorded during the 24-hour period. The value was produced by applying the maximum function to the set of minute-interval temperature readings.

temperatureMin.description: Least air temperature recorded during the 24-hour period. The value was produced by applying the minimum function to the set of minute-interval temperature readings.

temperatureMean.description: Arithmetic mean air temperature over the 24-hour period. The value was produced by applying the mean function to the set of minute-interval temperature readings.

precipitationTotal.description: Total liquid-equivalent precipitation accumulated over the 24-hour period. The value was produced by applying the sum function to the set of minute-interval tipping-bucket gauge increments.

pressureAtSnapshot.description: Station-level atmospheric pressure at the 23:00 UTC snapshot instant, produced directly by a digital barometric transducer without post-hoc computation.

dewPointDepression.description: Difference between the dry-bulb temperature and the dew-point temperature at the 23:00 UTC snapshot instant. Computed from dry-bulb and relative-humidity sensor readings using the Magnus approximation specified in WMO No. 8 (2018 edition) Annex 4.B. Because the result combines two sensor channels by a deterministic formula, and that formula is not a named statistic function, the derivation is 'calculated'.

precipitationProbabilityNextDay.description: Model-derived probability that liquid-equivalent precipitation will equal or exceed 1 mm during the following calendar day, produced by a numerical weather prediction ensemble post-processed with calibrated probability matching.
